{{Recipe}}

Fry sauce is a simple condiment, used often with fries. It uses one part of [[Cookbook:Tomato Ketchup|tomato ketchup]] with two parts of [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]].

==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]]
* 1 tsp tomato [[Cookbook:Ketchup|ketchup]]

==Procedure==
# Combine the mayonnaise and ketchup.
# Mix until the sauce is a strong pink colour.
